overall_reason: The system UI stack (Segoe UI drew every glyph at 1440 per fonts.json; system-ui computed at 375) sets every role, which fits a product-UI (Operate) composition with the same sizes and weights as a tuned ladder, but every text role in each panel is set in one colour, so only size and weight separate the heads from the meta.

score.reason: T-LADDER: the size and weight steps are intact, but each panel uses one colour for all roles (dom-1440.json), so the secondary step that orders rows and meta is gone.

findings.title: Create hierarchy with size, weight and space
findings.where: Window panel and preview card, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json every text element in the window ('Workspace files', 'Launch assets', 'Launch brief', 'Updated today', 'PDF') is rgb(101,113,124). Every element in the preview card ('Document preview', 'Launch brief' 17px/550, 'The release', 'Ready for review') is rgb(161,170,181). On P34/01-evidence/tiles/1440-00.png the file names read at the same strength as their 'Updated' lines.
findings.before: Head, item and meta share one colour per panel
findings.after: Keep the size and weight steps, and give primary text and meta two distinct tones (primary near the panel's darkest text value, meta one step lighter)
findings.why: When the head, the item and the meta share one tone, the reader has to read sizes to find the head.

strengths: The size and weight ladder is intact: 13/600, 16/550 and 17/550 heads over 10 to 11px text.
Leading is 1.3 to 1.6 throughout, and nothing is tracked or set in caps.
not_investigated: T-MEASURE: no paragraph of 3 or more lines at either width
Size floors under 12px (A11-002) and contrast belong to the sweep and the color lens; not repeated here

The low contrast of the washed palette is for the color lens and the sweep (A11-001)
